title: Max Dot Product of Two Subsequences
summary: Given two arrays, nums1 and nums2, find the highest dot product of non-empty subsequences of equal length from both arrays, where a subsequence is formed by removing some elements from the original array without changing the order of the remaining elements.
statement: Given two arrays, nums1 and nums2, find the highest dot product of non-empty subsequences of equal length from both arrays, where a subsequence is formed by removing some elements from the original array without changing the order of the remaining elements.
constraints: Choose non-empty subsequences of equal length while preserving each array’s order.
Return the maximum dot product; values may be negative.
hints: DP over prefixes of both arrays.
At each pair, skip either element, start with their product, or extend a positive diagonal result.
Keep the maximum of those choices.
Every valid pair of subsequences has a final matched pair and a preceding prefix solution, while explicit starting preserves non-emptiness.
editorial: Every valid pair of subsequences has a final matched pair and a preceding prefix solution, while explicit starting preserves non-emptiness.

tests.explanation: Pairing 2 with 3 and -2 with -6 gives eighteen.
The best one-pair subsequence is three times seven, giving twenty-one.
